verdict.rationale: Kit documents first-party webhooks. Integrations can register an endpoint URL, receive deliveries the moment account activity happens, and choose from listed available event types such as subscriber.unsubscribed and subscriber.bounced. Deliveries are signed with the endpoint's secret and failed ones are retried with backoff. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that webhook deliveries work as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks let your integration react to activity in a Kit account the moment it happens, instead of polling the API.
Every delivery is signed with your endpoint's secret so you can confirm it came from Kit and the body wasn't altered in transit.
Failed deliveries are retried with backoff: `30s`, `2m`, `15m`, `1h`, `4h`, `12h`, then `24h` — up to 8 attempts
